reviews.text:
Our large-breed Dogo Argentino has been treated by this vet for over 6 years, and we couldn't be more satisfied. During this time, he has operated on him twice: once for neutering and once for the removal of a malignant tumor. On both occasions, he demonstrated truly rare professionalism, expertise, and humanity.

He is always available: he responds quickly and has never left us alone, especially during the most difficult times. His boundless passion for animals is evident in every visit. He works with love and treats each patient as if they were his own.

The practice is clean, well-maintained, and conveniently located in Vomero.

I can only recommend him to anyone looking for a serious, knowledgeable, and truly passionate veterinarian. A great professional and, above all, a wonderful person. Thank you so much! 🫶🏼 A special thank you also from Chango! 🐾

A professional, humane, and non-commercial doctor, you can tell he does his job out of love for animals.
I would recommend him to anyone.
Professionalism and great empathy with "patients" and their companions

My puppy has been treated by Dr. Bancale for two years.
An excellent, professional, yet empathetic doctor.
I highly recommend it.
A sensitive, thorough, attentive, welcoming, and thorough doctor. A rare professional who assures peace and confidence in life.
